name: seld/jsonlint
input_api: Seld\JsonLint\JsonParser::parse(string $input, int $flags = 0) over local bytes; default flags decode objects to stdClass
scope: RFC 8259 JSON text decoded into PHP stdClass/array/scalar values with default flags
family: seld/jsonlint Lexer and LR table parser
family_note: Own pure-PHP Lexer.php and JsonParser.php LR parse table; the pinned source contains no json_decode call. String escapes are expanded by its own preg_replace_callback interpolation. Composer depends on it, which inflates its download count; Composer itself calls json_decode first and uses JsonParser to report errors.
not_verified: Only default flags on one valid UTF-8 object control were run. ALLOW_COMMENTS, duplicate-key flags, PARSE_TO_ASSOC, VALIDATE_UTF8_ENCODING, byte-order-mark input (rejected by failOnBOM), large integers, depth limits and malformed input are unverified.

name: halaxa/json-machine
input_api: JsonMachine\Items::fromString(string $input, array $options) over local JSON text; iteration yields top-level members; ExtJsonDecoder decodes each value
scope: JSON object or array roots; JSON Machine incrementally parses top-level members and PHP ext/json decodes each yielded member value
family: JSON Machine Lexer/Parser plus PHP ext/json member decoder
family_note: The package has its own streaming Lexer and Parser, but default ExtJsonDecoder delegates each value to json_decode. This composite family shares ext/json with the runtime path; the harness invokes Items::fromString directly and iterates every top-level member.
not_verified: Two valid nested object/array controls were run with exact structural summaries. Scalar roots, JSON Pointer paths, custom decoders, large streaming inputs, duplicate keys and malformed input remain unverified.
